title: NSB Utils
description: This is a Stoneblock Utils Mod for a modpack named New's Stoneblock that adds some nice utils for stoneblock
body:
🪨 NSB Utils
📘 Description NSB Utils is a lightweight add-on that expands your Stoneblock-style gameplay with a mix of classic and new items. This mod reintroduces familiar tools from the original Stoneblock, such as the Stone Crook and Stone Stick, while adding new content not found in the original — including the Cracked Stone block. It also brings new crafting recipes for the Exdeorum mod’s Stone Hammer, giving players more crafting options and smoother early-game progression. ⚒️ Features 🪓 Stone Crook and Stone Stick – classic tools return 🧱 Cracked Stone – new decorative and functional block 🔨 New Stone Hammer recipes for Exdeorum integration 💎 Balances old Stoneblock nostalgia with fresh new content 💡 Notes NSB Utils is designed to fit naturally into Stoneblock-inspired modpacks. It enhances the stone-based early game while keeping the familiar feel that players love.
